reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per parent category and day with sales
  SELECT parent_category, order_date, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY parent_category, order_date
), running AS (
  -- one row per parent category and day with sales
  SELECT parent_category, order_date,
    SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_category ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_units,
    SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY parent_category) AS total_units
  FROM daily
)
SELECT parent_category, MIN(order_date) AS half_units_date
FROM running
WHERE cumulative_units >= 0.5 * total_units
GROUP BY parent_category

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per parent category and day with sales
  SELECT parent_category, order_date, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY parent_category, order_date
)
SELECT d.parent_category, MIN(d.order_date) AS half_units_date
FROM daily d
WHERE (SELECT SUM(d2.units) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.parent_category = d.parent_category AND d2.order_date <= d.order_date)
      >= 0.5 * (SELECT SUM(d3.units) FROM daily d3 WHERE d3.parent_category = d.parent_category)
GROUP BY d.parent_category

SELECT parent_category, MIN(order_date) AS half_units_date
